hotels.title: Bellarine Peninsula Boutique Escape with Daily Breakfast Hamper & A$50 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Established in 1888, this charming seaside hotel is the Bellarine Peninsula’s heritage jewel. The century-old facade houses a spectacular modern refurbishment, paying homage to the hotel’s history as a seaman’s reprieve, while offering the highest standard of luxury. Portarlington is a region famous for its seafood and award-winning wine - don’t miss out on sampling the renowned produce onsite. The Atrium, a neighbourhood pub frequented by locals, serves fresh favourites like locally caught fish of the day. The Bistro takes it up a notch with signature Portarlington mussels, and local Bellarine distillers, breweries and wineries champion a thoughtful drinks menu at the Front Bar. Just over an hour’s ferry ride from Melbourne, Portarlington Grand Hotel couldn’t be better poised for exploring the peninsula. With return transfers to local wineries included in your stay, graze with a degustation board at Bennets Winery, sample award-winning drops at Jack Rabbit or soak up panoramic vineyard views at Terindah Estate (additional charges apply).

hotels.title: Bellarine Peninsula Award-Winning Adults-Only Retreat with Private Cinema & Cocktail Lounge
hotels.description: An escape from everyday life beckons at Starhaven Retreat, a contemporary hideaway set amid the striking beauty of the Bellarine Peninsula with its beaches, lakes, wineries and stunning views. A short drive yet a world away from Melbourne's CBD, this award-winning property - which featured on Grand Designs Australia - overlooks tranquil Port Phillip Bay and offers guests the opportunity to curate their own escape, with a spa, cocktail lounge, 15-seat cinema with a starlit ceiling and all-suite accommodation with private ensuite bathrooms. Joining the growth to green, Starhaven Retreat enjoys Tripadvisor GreenLeaders Platinum Level certification and promotes numerous environmental initiatives among the three categories of electricity, water and recycling. From the production of energy from solar power and using water from 20,000L water tanks to using FSC Certified papers and recycling rigorously, this retreat strives for a sustainable future, without compromising on luxury. If you can tear yourself away from the comfort of your accommodation, Victoria's Bellarine Peninsula is bursting with natural delights. Stroll along pristine beaches, discover the rich history of Geelong and taste spectacular local food and wine, freshly produced by some of Australia’s most awarded makers and growers. Browse local art galleries, sample the fare of local breweries and wineries, stroll the markets and while an afternoon away to live music: it's all here on the Bellarine Peninsula.
